content:
[Intro]

[tab][ch]G[/ch]                 [ch]Am[/ch]     [ch]Bb[/ch]         [ch]F[/ch]                 [ch]C[/ch]
Fare you well, my honey, fare you well my only true one.[/tab]
[tab][ch]G[/ch]                       [ch]Dm[/ch]          [ch]Bb[/ch]                 [ch]C[/ch]          [ch]F[/ch]
All the birds that were singing are flown, except you alone.[/tab]


[Verse 1]

[tab][ch]F[/ch]                    [ch]Bb[/ch]
Going to leave this brokedown palace,[/tab]
[tab]      [ch]F[/ch]            [ch]Dm[/ch]            [ch]Bb[/ch]           [ch]F[/ch]
On my hands and my knees, I will roll, roll, roll.[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]             [ch]Am[/ch]         [ch]Bb[/ch]    [ch]F[/ch]
Make myself a bed by the waterside,[/tab]
[tab]                  [ch]G[/ch]            [ch]Bb[/ch]          [ch]F[/ch]
In my time, In my time, I will roll, roll roll.[/tab]


[Chorus 1]

[tab][ch]F[/ch]         [ch]A[/ch]
In a bed, in a bed,[/tab]
[tab]       [ch]Bb[/ch]                [ch]F[/ch]      [ch]G[/ch]
By the waterside I will lay my head.[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]                     [ch]G[/ch]                   [ch]Bb[/ch]      [ch]F[/ch]
Listen to the river sing sweet songs, to rock my soul.[/tab]


[Verse 2]

[tab][ch]F[/ch]                       [ch]Bb[/ch]
River going to take me, sing me sweet and sleepy,[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]                 [ch]Dm[/ch]             [ch]Bb[/ch]       [ch]F[/ch]
Sing me sweet and sleepy all the way back home.[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]                 [ch]Am[/ch]           [ch]Bb[/ch]        [ch]F[/ch]
It's a far gone lullaby, sung many years ago.[/tab]
[tab]                [ch]G[/ch]                      [ch]Bb[/ch]            [ch]F[/ch]
Mama, mama many worlds I've come since I first left home.[/tab]


[Chorus 2]

[tab][ch]F[/ch]           [ch]A[/ch]
Goin' home, goin' home,[/tab]
[tab]       [ch]Bb[/ch]                [ch]F[/ch]       [ch]G[/ch]
By the waterside I will rest my bones,[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]                   [ch]G[/ch]                    [ch]Bb[/ch]       [ch]F[/ch]
Listen to the river sing sweet songs, to rock my soul.[/tab]


[Verse 3]

[tab][ch]F[/ch]                [ch]Bb[/ch]
Going to plant a weeping willow,[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]                   [ch]Dm[/ch]            [ch]Bb[/ch]           [ch]F[/ch]
On the bank's green edge it will grow, grow, grow.[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]           [ch]Am[/ch]   [ch]Bb[/ch]         [ch]F[/ch]
Sing a lullaby beside the water,[/tab]
[tab]                [ch]G[/ch]             [ch]Bb[/ch]           [ch]F[/ch]
Lovers come and go, the river roll, roll, roll.[/tab]


[Chorus 3]

[tab][ch]F[/ch]              [ch]A[/ch]
Fare you well, fare you well,[/tab]
[tab]  [ch]Bb[/ch]                  [ch]F[/ch]         [ch]G[/ch]
I love you more than words can tell,[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]                   [ch]G[/ch]                    [ch]Bb[/ch]       [ch]F[/ch]
Listen to the river sing sweet songs, to rock my soul.[/tab]


[Outro]

[tab]       [ch]F[/ch]              [ch]Bb[/ch]
Doo do doo, do da do, doo-oo[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]       [ch]G[/ch]       [ch]Bb[/ch]     [ch]F[/ch]
Doo, do doo, da doo da doo[/tab]
[tab]       [ch]F[/ch]              [ch]Bb[/ch]     [ch]F[/ch]
Doo do doo, do da do, doo da doo[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]       [ch]G[/ch]       [ch]Bb[/ch]     [ch]F[/ch]
Doo, do doo, da doo da doo[/tab]
[tab]      [ch]F[/ch]       [ch]G[/ch]       [ch]Bb[/ch]     [ch]F[/ch]
Do do Doo, do doo, da doo da doo[/tab]
